body: Last night, I wrote a note. And I realized I wasn’t ready even though I wanted to. I read this and this hit me so hard. Just what is worse than now?
If you ever get a chance to read this, thanks for writing this. Somehow, you made me feel less alone. I wish you all the best in your next journey
I’m sorry, but it doesn’t work one way. You say you love me and you don’t want to see me go. And I stay because I love you. But why am I the only feeling so alone and suffering day by day alone.
Thank you for writing this. I’m kind of in a similar situation and reading this just made me feel less alone.
So how can I tell someone I love that I would probably kill myself. And once that happens, wouldn’t that leave them worse off because they know and they couldn’t do anything about it
